def solution():

    working_capital = 240_000
    total_assets = 1_200_000
    retained_earnings = 350_000
    ebit = 150_000
    market_value_of_equity = 850_000
    total_liabilities = 600_000
    sales = 750_000

    # Calculate the Altman Z-score
    a = working_capital / total_assets
    b = retained_earnings / total_assets
    c = ebit / total_assets
    d = market_value_of_equity / total_liabilities
    e = sales / total_assets

    z_score = 1.2 * a + 1.4 * b + 3.3 * c + 0.6 * d + e

    # Return the score rounded to two decimal places
    return round(z_score, 2)
